result.requirement: The system shall send real-time notifications to customers regarding the status updates of their refund requests.
result.business_need: The business needs to maintain customer trust and reduce support volume by providing immediate transparency on refund processing stages.
functional_behaviour: The system shall automatically generate a notification when a refund request transitions from pending to approved or rejected.
The system shall include the updated refund status and the expected timeline for funds to appear in the customer's account within the notification.
The system shall deliver the notification via the communication channel previously selected by the customer in their profile.
The system shall log the timestamp and content of every status notification sent to the customer for audit purposes.
The system shall suppress duplicate notifications if the refund status has not changed since the last message.
related_information_requirements: Current status of the refund request
Preferred communication channel of the customer
business_rules: A notification must be sent immediately upon any change in the refund request status.
Notifications must only be sent if the new status differs from the status of the most recent notification.
The notification content must accurately reflect the current state of the Financial Transaction Record.
The system must verify the active communication channel exists before attempting to send a notification.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer has submitted a refund request that is currently pending
acceptance_criteria.when: The system updates the request status to approved
acceptance_criteria.then: The system sends a notification to the customer confirming the approval and the expected fund arrival date

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer has received a notification about a pending refund request
acceptance_criteria.when: The system updates the request status to rejected without changing the status again
acceptance_criteria.then: The system does not send another notification to the customer
